assumptions: an UNAVAILABLE proof rung yields an INSUFFICIENT attempt (unavailable_behavior = insufficient, the frozen DP), never a pass and never a demonstrated failure
the same frozen contract stays green on L0 (unit checks) across every attempt
repairs carry a minimal source change (campaign COUNTER note) solely to exercise the bounded repair budget (NO_SOURCE_CHANGE refusal would otherwise block)
constraints: the rungs stay unknowable for the whole Job — no encoding fixes; this Job exists to prove the fail-closed path
plan.objective: Run C: rung honesty. Two frozen invariants are L0-true but formally unknowable: one carries a Kani harness that cannot compile (rung UNAVAILABLE), the other a Creusot targets list naming a ghost item (zero generated goals → UNAVAILABLE). Every attempt must land INSUFFICIENT with UNAVAILABLE rung rows; after 8 attempts the Job goes terminal insufficient_evidence, spent once, with the UNAVAILABLE rows preserved in the signed artifact. An accepted verdict here would falsify the never-silent-pass invariant.

overall_acceptance.description: Terminal verdict insufficient_evidence on attempt-budget exhaustion; every attempt row shows both rungs UNAVAILABLE (kani compile-kill + ghost target) with the L0 checks green on every attempt; one entitlement spent at the terminal verdict; signed artifact verifiable keyless.

evidence.description: the signed report's per-attempt invariant rows (rung decisions) + verdict + entitlement posture

failure_conditions: any accepted attempt with an UNAVAILABLE rung
any attempt verdict failed on a rung that merely could not run (a compile-killed harness is UNAVAILABLE, not a violation)
zero-goal creusot tallies read as proven

acceptance.description: the kani rung for the naming invariant reports UNAVAILABLE every attempt (harness fails to compile; no verdict), the attempt is INSUFFICIENT, and no counterexample is invented.

evidence.description: per-attempt rung row: decision unavailable, exit/compile evidence in the tail

failure_conditions: rung treated as violated (would make the attempt failed on noise)

work_items.outcome: kani = proofs/broken_kani.rs (intentionally uncompilable): the L1 rung cannot produce a verdict → UNAVAILABLE every attempt.

acceptance.description: the creusot rung for the link invariant reports zero matched goals → UNAVAILABLE every attempt (the zero-goals rule), never proven.

evidence.description: per-attempt rung row: goals total 0 / decision unavailable

failure_conditions: goals_total == 0 mapped to proven (the silent-pass attack)
the ghost target silently ignored while the rung reports proven

work_items.outcome: [invariant.creusot] targets = ["ghost_item_no_such_fn"]: the pattern matches nothing → the zero-goals rule makes the L2 rung UNAVAILABLE every attempt.

acceptance.description: 8 attempts total, all INSUFFICIENT; the 8th exhausts REPAIR_EXHAUSTED to terminal insufficient_evidence; entitlement consumed exactly once at that terminal verdict; the report carries all 8 attempt rows with UNAVAILABLE rung decisions.

evidence.description: terminal report attempt list + account posture

work_items.outcome: The bounded-repair budget plays out to exhaustion under a honestly-unknowable rung, producing the terminal insufficient_evidence record.
